title: Africa coverage evidence tranche 2B - Namibia, Sierra Leone, Somalia, Senegal, Tanzania

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: Namibia's Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security identifies its Department of Immigration Control and Citizenship and describes responsibility for lawful migration through visas, permits, border controls, and citizenship services.

The Sierra Leone Immigration Department official portal identifies the department as responsible for regulating immigration and provides visa, visa-on-arrival, residence-permit, passport, and travel-document services.

Somalia's Immigration and Citizenship Agency official page identifies the agency as the issuer of immigration entry permits and lists work, business, residence, medical, student, transit, tourist, and other visa categories.
Senegal's Ministry of African Integration and Foreign Affairs publishes the official entry-visa requirements, exemption list, application steps, and consular issuance process.

The Tanzania Immigration Department official portal identifies the department and explains residence permits for foreign nationals undertaking investment, business, employment, research, retirement, and other lawful activities.

batch.name: v10.22.22 Africa evidence tranche 2B - NA, SL, SO, SN, TZ
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Namibia (NA), Sierra Leone (SL), Somalia (SO), Senegal (SN), and Tanzania (TZ). All five endpoints were probed on 2026-07-18 through the controlled API-container retriever and returned HTTPS 200 with usable generic-parser content. The tranche is limited to the narrow visa, permit, residence, border, and citizenship functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Namibia Department of Immigration Control and Citizenship page
immigration_assessment.rationale: Namibia's Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security identifies its Department of Immigration Control and Citizenship and states that it facilitates lawful migration through visas, permits, entry and departure controls, and citizenship services. This supports a proposal that Namibia directly administers the relevant immigration services through the department.

source_onboarding.evidence_notes: Controlled API-container probe on 2026-07-18 returned HTTPS 200 with 2,863 characters of extracted content covering the department's mandate, visas, permits, border controls, and citizenship. Keep the initial certification limited to the services explicitly described.
